slice: checkpoint runtime composition ports, owner-only capture command handler and production-host blocker accounting
purpose: Bridge the H5-B1 isolated checkpoint module to the Runtime composition layer without activating live restore: injectable host ports (control DB backup, Goal session log export via an injected resolver, memory export unavailable, shared-object inventory), an owner-only single-flight capture command handler, and an explicit accounting that the current production composition cannot become ready until the host provides the required scopes.

implementation.hostPorts: new host-ports.ts: ControlSourcePort copies the real control SQLite DB with node:sqlite backup plus a read-only live precheck via existing ControlStore requests; GoalSessionPort enumerates active bindings from the control store and exports exact native Session logs only via an injected path resolver (candidate: the installed JSONL backend resolveCurrentLog, marked non-contract diagnostic; no guessed paths) with flush/native-state/projection evidence injected; MemoryExportPort is explicitly MEMORY_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE in production with the required scope; SharedObjectPort inventories dataDir/workspaces read-only with per-file/aggregate hashes and rejects symlinks/escapes; composition requires staging outside the live root and allowed staging roots, and only returns ready after all four required components are complete and verifyBundleDirectory re-hashes the staged bytes.
implementation.command: new runtime-command.ts: owner-only runtime.checkpoint.capture handler (strict fields, single-flight busy without queueing, paused allowed without changing pause state, explicit trigger only, no GET path, no automatic retry, structured failure degradation, path redaction); a lazily created composition; the exact runtime.ts integration diff is provided as a separate patch (7839 bytes, git apply --check passes).
implementation.b1Extensions: additive H5-B1 compatibility fields control.livePrecheck, dsh-goal-sessions.excludedBindings, shared-objects.workspaceInventory and restore-report.goalExclusions; capture gains liveDataRoot/allowedStagingRoots fences and explicit goal exclusions; old H5-B1 evidence is left untouched as historical.
implementation.productionHost: the real production composition cannot be ready in this slice: GOAL_SESSION_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE (no public read-only exact log path / native Goal state / durability barrier / exportable projection or offline-decodable format) and MEMORY_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE (no public managed-Ombre export/archive API); capture returns incomplete with per-component required scope and never a temp fallback; the ready path is proven only with synthetic seams and isolated-root restore.
